## Missing or Unclear Documentation

What documentation is missing, outdated, or unclear?

## Location

Where should this be documented? (e.g., `docs/architecture/overview.md`, `README.md`, `docs/android/development.md`)

## Proposed Improvement

Describe what should be added or changed. If possible, include a draft or outline.

## Additional Context

Links, references, or related issues.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing documentation and issues for this topic
- [ ] I am willing to contribute the documentation myself (optional, check if true)
